title: Why a² + b² = c²
learning_goal: See why rearranging four congruent right triangles proves a²+b²=c²
subject: mathematics
must_not_claim: The identity applies to triangles without a right angle

approved_facts.statement: Rearranging four congruent right triangles inside the same square preserves the remaining area when both endpoint arrangements tile without overlaps.
A right triangle with leg lengths a and b and hypotenuse c satisfies a²+b²=c². For a=3 and b=4, the square areas are 9,16,25 and c=5.
